setting_0.description: ReachabilityAnalysis.jl 0.33.0 with TMJets (tools/juliareach/Project.toml) and one initial box. abstol/orderT/orderQ per benchmark family as in the original scripts (2D benchmarks: abstol 1e-12, orderT 7; CP_LQR and MAS_CON: abstol 1e-10, orderT 5); maxsteps raised from the default 2000 so that the horizon is not cut short silently. The vector field is generated from the config and @taylorize'd. Benchmarks that are not a forward problem from one initial box to one target box are reported as unsupported and their parameters are not used.
